title: Doe Records: duotone photos and a word that turns italic halfway
note: A Portland record label. Every photo is printed as red-orange duotone on cream, like risograph. Headings are a condensed serif that switches to italic mid-word (ART|ISTS), body text is justified in two columns with a drop cap, and the nav is lowercase serif. The marquee carries a real announcement (membership is here). Readymag Websites of the Year 2023, impact runner-up. Worth taking: one print process applied to every image makes the whole site look like one object.
